BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

2. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

3. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

5. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.

6. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.

7. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

8. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

9. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

12. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

14. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

15. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

16. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
